core_obligations: Compare the Cech complexes: for generators of the ideal the Cech complex of the source tensored with the ring maps is canonically the Cech complex of the target with respect to the images of the generators (proof lines 1589-1597)

Pass to complexes: represent the object by a K-flat complex and observe that the two total complexes computing the two sides of the asserted formula agree under that identification (proof lines 1598-1608)

difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that local cohomology with respect to a finitely generated ideal commutes with base change along a ring homomorphism (author lemma at source lines 1578-1587, label lemma-torsion-change-rings). The proof (source lines 1589-1609) identifies the Cech complexes attached to the generators of the two ideals after tensoring with the ring, represents the object by a K-flat complex and concludes through the Cech description of local cohomology (proof lines 1589-1608). The identification of the two complexes is the substance. H3.
